corrections.title: 三十代天师虚靖先生语录
corrections.note: Schipper/CRTA: DZ1249 = 三十代天師虛靖真君語錄 (張繼先撰、張宇初編). DZ1248 is 三洞群仙錄. Standard title uses 真君 not 先生.

corrections.title: 太上三天正法经
corrections.note: Schipper/Komjathy/CRTA: 太上三天正法經 = DZ/CT 1203. DZ1204 is 太上正一法文經.

corrections.title: 道要灵祇神鬼品经
corrections.note: Schipper/Verellen/Komjathy/CRTA: 道要靈祇神鬼品經 = DZ/CT 1201. DZ1202 is 洞神八帝元變經.

corrections.title: 周易参同契发挥
corrections.note: Yu Yan 俞琰 周易參同契發揮 = DZ1005 (CRTA/Pregadio). DZ998 is 讀龍虎經.

corrections.title: 周易参同契解
corrections.note: Chen Xianwei 陳顯微 周易參同契解 = DZ1007. DZ1000 is anonymous 周易參同契註 (not 解).

corrections.title: 周易参同契注
corrections.note: DZ1001 is Zhu Xi 朱熹 周易參同契考異, not a 注. Daozang 注 editions: DZ999 (陰真人), DZ1000 (無名氏), DZ1008 (儲華谷).

corrections.title: 周易参同契考异
corrections.note: Zhu Xi 朱熹 周易參同契考異 = DZ1001 (Pregadio/CRTA). DZ995 is not this text.

corrections.title: 周易参同契注
corrections.note: DZ994 is not a 周易參同契注 (nearby: 古文龍虎經 materials). Valid 注: DZ999, 1000, 1008.

corrections.title: 周易参同契注
corrections.note: DZ993 is not a 周易參同契注. Valid Schipper numbers for 注: DZ999 (陰真人), DZ1000 (無名氏), DZ1008 (儲華谷).

corrections.title: 周易参同契注
corrections.note: DZ997 = 古文龍虎上經註, not 周易參同契注. Valid 注: DZ999, 1000, 1008.

corrections.title: 周易参同契释疑
corrections.note: Yu Yan 俞琰 周易參同契釋疑 = DZ1006 (follows 發揮 DZ1005). DZ999 is 周易參同契註 (陰真人).

corrections.title: 黄庭内景五脏六腑补泻图
corrections.note: Hu Yin 胡愔 黃庭內景五臟六腑補瀉圖 = DZ432 (Komjathy/Brill). DZ431 is 上清含象劍鑑圖.

corrections.title: 古文龙虎经注疏
corrections.note: Wang Dao 王道 古文龍虎經註疏 = DZ996 (CRTA/Komjathy/Pregadio). DZ990 is a different text.
